title: AUTH-1 enrolled approval keys
description: GET /v1/auth/keys. Shows both of AUTH-1's switches: `enabled` is the host preference, and each key carries the device's own. A public key is never returned - the list is an inventory, not a key distribution point.

enabled.description: The host's `biometric_auth` preference. False means no approval is ever raised, whatever any device has registered.

challenge.description: One-shot, 300 s, per device. Enrolling signs it, and it is spent whether or not the signature was good.

enabled.description: The device's own switch, as the device reported it. A key with this false is registered and not in any audience.
